revision_note: final pre-run implementation checkout and adapter-byte binding after evaluator and telemetry hardening; zero formal provider calls before this revision

pva: The host has no working read-deny isolation primitive that can prevent the author process from opening evaluator-only benchmark files; Codex workspace-write constrains writes but not repository reads.
lam: LAM config.yaml, the selected OpenAI provider environment, and Node dependencies are not ready.
Common-evaluator feedback/repair, failed-output preservation, run-id output isolation, and normalized attempt telemetry are not implemented.
articraft: The native CLI resolves --data-dir but does not pass the isolated data root into run_from_input storage.
Common-evaluator invocation, common-repair orchestration, and normalized result writing are not implemented.

blockers: PVA author-process read isolation is not enforced.
LAM has three environment and five adapter blockers.
Articraft native storage isolation and common evaluator/repair/result wiring are incomplete.

common_evaluator.excluded_from_table1_gate: All measurable_constraints entries; they are reserved for the Constraints or Articulation axes.

implementation.provenance: Local pipeline mirror of the mattzh72/articraft codebase; not the supported successor checkout

attempt_semantics.attempt_0: The first emitted model generation for one method-task-repeat tuple before evaluator feedback. A provider transport retry that emits no model output is not a new attempt.
attempt_semantics.common_repair: One new model generation after receiving only bounded structured feedback from the frozen common evaluator. Attempts 1 through 3 are common repairs.
attempt_semantics.native_retry: A method-native retry for a transient provider or tool failure, using the identical request and no evaluator feedback. It is logged separately, does not consume the common repair budget, and cannot overwrite an emitted output.

metric_definitions.executable: The emitted source executes in the frozen isolated method adapter within 180 seconds and exits with code zero.
metric_definitions.artifact_saved: Execution saves nonempty source, one parseable URDF, and every referenced nonempty mesh beneath the isolated run root.
metric_definitions.common_qc: Executable and Artifact Saved pass; URDF is a connected acyclic single-root tree; every required role meets min_count; every required joint matches parent role, child role, type, signed parent-frame axis within 12 degrees, and covers the frozen lower/upper limits within 0.05 SI units; required mimic relationships are present; all bindings match. Reserved measurable constraints are excluded.
metric_definitions.first_shot: attempt_0 passes executable, artifact_saved, and common_qc.
metric_definitions.final_success: An attempt from 0 through 3 passes executable, artifact_saved, and common_qc.
metric_definitions.repair_turns: Number of common evaluator feedback-to-new-generation transitions before terminal success or exhaustion. Native retries are excluded.

hidden_policy.feedback_may_reveal: Only failed common-gate identifiers and bounded diagnostics; never the expected role list, axis, limits, thresholds, reserved constraints, or another method's output.

telemetry_requirements.missing_value_policy: Preserve null with an explicit reason; never impute paper, release, or proxy telemetry.
